manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Mysterious Limousine to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mysterious Limousine and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
